title: Pippin Pika's Little Haystack
description: When a gust of wind scatters Pippin's gathered grass, a helpful chipmunk shows him that teamwork makes everything better.

scenes.narration: Pippin Pika lived high on a sunny rocky mountain peak. He loved gathering sweet mountain grass to build cozy winter stacks.
scenes.visual: A fluffy pika animal picking tall green stems of grass on a rocky hill

scenes.narration: Just as Pippin finished a large stack, a sudden swooping mountain breeze blew across the rocks and scattered his grass everywhere.
scenes.visual: Gusts of wind blowing dry grass stalks high into the blue sky

scenes.narration: Pippin sat on a warm stone, feeling sad as he watched his hard morning work tumble down the grassy hillside.
scenes.visual: A sad pika sitting on a stone watching grass drift away in wind

scenes.narration: Suddenly, a friendly chipmunk scrambled down from a boulder with a wide, cheery grin and an armful of fresh green grass stems.
scenes.visual: A friendly chipmunk carrying a armful of green grass stems toward a pika

scenes.narration: Together, they scurried up and down the rocks, collecting all the scattered blades and building a brand new, twice-as-big stack.
scenes.visual: A pika and a chipmunk bundling grass together on a sunlit stone

scenes.narration: Pippin hugged his chipmunk friend with gratitude. Working together had turned a tough mistake into a fun game.
scenes.visual: Two small mountain animals sitting beside a big pile of gathered grass

scenes.narration: Close your eyes and sleep peacefully tonight. Follow along for more gentle mountain tales every single evening.
scenes.visual: A calm twilight mountain view with soft orange clouds and gentle stars
